items.title: RTX's Collins targets Asia's growing regional aircraft fleet with India repair hub
items.summary: Nov 16 (Reuters) - RTX's Collins Aerospace is setting up a multimillion-dollar aircraft propeller repair centre ‌in Bengaluru as it seeks a bigger share of the $120 ‌billion global aircraft maintenance market, a top executive told Reuters on Tuesday. The facility, ​expected to begin operations by 2028, will inspect, repair and maintain aircraft propeller systems for India's fast-growing aviation sector, the Indian Air Force and regional operators across Asia-Pacific.

items.title: Amazon Lost 40 Leo Satellites as Launch Stays “Extremely Constrained.” That Widens SpaceX’s Lead
items.summary: Key TakeawaysA United Launch Alliance Vulcan rocket failed on Sunday and destroyed 40 Amazon Leo satellites on the first of 38 Vulcan launches Amazon has bought. Amazon can easily afford new satellites, but Vulcan was supposed to carry more than 1,500 of them, and few other rockets have room for the rest.

items.title: Lies, spies and sex are just one part of the Nvidia story. The real stakes are much bigger
items.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned from the company he founded this week after reports of multiple affairs, including one with a subordinate and one with a woman whom US officials feared could be working with Chinese intelligence.

items.title: Boeing (BA) ULA Rocket Failure Halts Deployment Of 40 Broadband Satellites
items.summary: Boeing (NYSE:BA) part-owned United Launch Alliance reported a rocket failure while carrying 40 Amazon satellites on a recent mission. The malfunction interrupted deployment of Amazon's planned space broadband constellation, delaying service timelines for the technology project. The incident raises execution questions for Boeing's space joint venture and its ability to secure future commercial launch contracts.
